title: YAML
label: YAML
desc: Human-readable data serialization used for config files, pipelines and manifests.

sections.title: Syntax
sections.description: A document is a tree of keys and values written with spaces.

snippets.code:
# Comments start with a hash and run to the end of the line
name: cheatrs
version: 2
enabled: true
tags:
  - cli
  - rust

---
# The start marker is optional, but makes the document boundary explicit
project: cheatrs
maintainer: felipe
...

sections.title: Scalars
sections.description: Plain values are read as strings, numbers, booleans or null.

snippets.code:
name: cheatrs
port: 8080
ratio: 3.14
debug: false
missing: null
quoted_number: "8080"   # stays a string
released: 2026-11-04

# Null has several spellings
first: null
second: Null
third: ~
fourth:

# Keys are plain scalars too
app-name: cheatrs
app_env: production

sections.title: Quoting Strings
sections.description: Quote a value when YAML syntax or type inference would misread it.

snippets.code:
plain: hello world
single: 'it''s a literal $HOME'   # only '' is an escape
double: "line\nbreak and \u00e9"  # backslash escapes work here
number_as_text: "0755"
with_colon: "key: value"
empty: ""

# Single quotes keep backslashes literal
path: 'C:\Users\felipe'

# Double quotes interpret escapes
message: "tab\there"
windows_path: "C:\\Users\\felipe"
hash: "# not a comment while quoted"

sections.title: Lists and Mappings
sections.description: Block style uses dashes and indentation; flow style uses brackets.

snippets.code:
# Block sequence
ports:
  - 80
  - 443

# Block mapping
database:
  host: localhost
  port: 5432

# Sequence of mappings
users:
  - name: ana
    role: admin
  - name: bruno
    role: viewer

sections.title: Nesting
sections.description: Spaces decide which block a key belongs to; tabs are not allowed.

snippets.code:
app:
  name: cheatrs
  server:
    host: 0.0.0.0
    port: 8080
    tls:
      enabled: true
      cert: /etc/ssl/cheatrs.pem
  features:
    - search
    - preview

# A dash may share its line with the first key of a mapping
jobs:
  - name: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  - name: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

sections.title: Multi-line Strings
sections.description: Literal blocks keep line breaks; folded blocks join lines with spaces.

snippets.code:
literal: |
  first line
  second line
  third line

folded: >
  this text is
  joined into one line

stripped: |-
  no trailing newline

indented: |2
    two leading spaces kept

# Blank lines become paragraph breaks in folded text
description: >
  A terminal browser for programming cheatsheets.

  Two columns to find a topic, one to read it.

sections.title: Anchors and Aliases
sections.description: Name a node with & and repeat the same value with *.

snippets.code:
# &labels a node, * reuses it
base: &base
  retries: 3
  timeout: 30

primary: *base
secondary: *base

# Scalars and sequences can be anchored too
region: &region eu-west-1
replicas: &replicas 3

production:
  region: *region
  replicas: *replicas
  zones: [eu-west-1a, eu-west-1b]

sections.title: Merge Keys
sections.description: The << key copies mappings in and local keys win; it comes from YAML 1.1.

snippets.code:
defaults: &defaults
  image: nginx:1.27-alpine
  restart: always
  logging:
    driver: json-file

web:
  <<: *defaults
  image: nginx:1.27
  ports:
    - "8080:80"

base: &base
  timeout: 30
  retries: 3
secure: &secure
  tls: true

service:
  <<: [*base, *secure]
  retries: 5   # this local key overrides the merged value

sections.title: Data Types
sections.description: Core schema types: strings, integers, floats, booleans and timestamps.

snippets.code:
text: plain string
integer: 42
negative: -7
hex: 0x2A
octal: 0o52
float: 3.14
exponent: 1.2e3
enabled: true
disabled: false
nothing: null
moment: 2026-11-04T10:30:00Z
day: 2026-11-04

# YAML 1.2 core schema does not treat these words as booleans
legacy_yes: yes    # boolean only in YAML 1.1 parsers
legacy_on: on      # same caveat
quoted_bool: "true"   # always a string

sections.title: Multiple Documents
sections.description: --- starts a document and ... ends it, so one stream holds many.

snippets.code:
---
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
data:
  mode: production

---
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: app-secret
type: Opaque
...

import yaml

with open("manifests.yaml") as handle:
    documents = list(yaml.safe_load_all(handle))

for document in documents:
    print(document["kind"], document["metadata"]["name"])

sections.title: YAML and JSON
sections.description: YAML 1.2 is a superset of JSON, and yq converts between both.

snippets.code:
# A JSON object is also a valid YAML document
{"name": "cheatrs", "version": 2, "tags": ["cli", "rust"]}

# JSON to YAML, pretty printed
yq -P config.json > config.yaml

# YAML to JSON
yq -o=json config.yaml > config.json

import json
import yaml

data = yaml.safe_load("name: cheatrs\nport: 8080")
print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))

sections.title: Docker Compose Example
sections.description: Services, health checks and a named volume in one compose file.

snippets.code:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    environment:
      APP_ENV: production
      TZ: America/Sao_Paulo
    volumes:
      - ./site:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  api:
    build:
      context: ./api
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://app:secret@db:5432/app
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:3000/health"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_started

  db:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: app
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: secret
      POSTGRES_DB: app
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data

volumes:
  pgdata:

sections.title: GitHub Actions Example
sections.description: A workflow that tests two Node versions and deploys after them.

snippets.code:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

# Second job in the same workflow file
  deploy:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/deploy.sh
        env:
          API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.API_TOKEN }}

sections.title: Kubernetes Example
sections.description: A Deployment with probes and limits, plus the Service in front of it.

snippets.code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cheatrs-api
  labels:
    app: cheatrs-api
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: cheatrs-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: cheatrs-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: ghcr.io/felipe/cheatrs-api:1.4.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: RUST_LOG
              value: info
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: cheatrs-api
spec:
  selector:
    app: cheatrs-api
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
  type: ClusterIP

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.description: Tabs, missing spaces and unquoted values fail in ways that look harmless.

snippets.code:
# Wrong: no space after the colon
# name:cheatrs

# Right
name: cheatrs

# Wrong: unquoted value containing a colon and space
# title: Cheatrs: terminal browser

# Right
title: "Cheatrs: terminal browser"

# Wrong: version read as the float 1.1
# version: 1.10

# Right
version: "1.10"

# Wrong: a tab used for indentation (shown escaped in the comment)
# server:
# \tport: 8080

# Right: spaces only
server:
  port: 8080

# Wrong: duplicate keys, the last one silently wins
# port: 8080
# port: 9090

# Quote anything that must stay text
country_code: "NO"   # bare NO is false in YAML 1.1
zip: "01234"         # bare 01234 is an integer
revision: "1.10"     # bare 1.10 is the float 1.1

sections.title: Linters and Parsers
sections.description: Validate, query and convert YAML from the command line.

snippets.code:
# Install the Python tooling
pip install pyyaml yamllint

# Lint syntax and style
yamllint config.yaml

# Check formatting with Prettier
npx prettier --check config.yaml

# Read one value with yq v4
yq '.services.web.image' compose.yaml

# Fail with a non-zero exit code when the value is null
yq -e '.services.api.image' compose.yaml

# Convert the whole file to JSON
yq -o=json config.yaml

import yaml

with open("config.yaml") as handle:
    config = yaml.safe_load(handle)

print(config["server"]["port"])
